newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada same-day trips to U.S. fall in June.
newsitem.headline: Canada same-day trips to U.S. fall in June.

text.p: Canadians made 2.8 million same-day trips to the United States in June, the lowest number in more than nine years, Statistics Canada said on Friday.
Same-day trips to the United States fell 1.7 percent from May, StatsCan said, tying the drop to the weakness of the Canadian dollar against the U.S. currency.

Residents from countries other than the United States made 354,000 trips of one or more nights to Canada in June, down 1.6 percent from May. Overnight trips from overseas have been declining steadily since February, StatsCan said.
The agency noted that the Canadian dollar had gained strength against many European currencies and the Japanese yen in the past year.

Americans made 1.1 million overnight trips to Canada in June, down 1.9 percent from May, the agency said. Americans made 2 million day trips to Canada, down 4 percent from May, the largest monthly drop since March 1995.
Canadians made 1.6 million overnight trips abroad in June, up 1.1 percent from May, and 1.3 million overnight trips to the United States, a rise of 0.7 percent from May.
